description: This file defines the PageAgent class for managing page interactions, events, and worker data in a Firefox browser context, including event handling, frame and navigation management, and worker lifecycle.

classes.name: WorkerData
classes.description: Manages communication and lifecycle of worker channels associated with the page.

classes.name: PageAgent
classes.description: Handles page events, frame management, worker lifecycle, and interaction with the browser context.

methods.name: _emitAllEvents
methods.description: Emits DOMContentLoaded and load events for a given frame.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new JavaScript execution context.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of a JavaScript execution context.

methods.name: _onWorkerCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of a new worker, setting up communication channels.

methods.name: _onWorkerDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a worker is destroyed.

methods.name: _onWindowOpen
methods.description: Handles window open events, triggering page events if conditions are met.

methods.name: _linkClicked
methods.description: Handles link click events, emitting corresponding events.

methods.name: _onWindowOpenInNewContext
methods.description: Handles new window creation in a new context.

methods.name: _filePickerShown
methods.description: Handles file picker dialog shown event.

methods.name: _findFrameForNode
methods.description: Finds the frame associated with a DOM node.

methods.name: onWindowEvent
methods.description: Handles window load and DOMContentLoaded events.

methods.name: _onRuntimeError
methods.description: Handles runtime errors from JavaScript execution contexts.

methods.name: _onDocumentOpenLoad
methods.description: Handles document load events.

methods.name: _onNavigationStarted
methods.description: Handles navigation start events.

methods.name: _onNavigationAborted
methods.description: Handles navigation abort events.

methods.name: _onSameDocumentNavigation
methods.description: Handles same-document navigation events.

methods.name: _onNavigationCommitted
methods.description: Handles navigation commit events.

methods.name: _onFrameAttached
methods.description: Handles frame attachment events.

methods.name: _onFrameDetached
methods.description: Handles frame detachment events.

methods.name: _onBindingCalled
methods.description: Handles calls to page bindings.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and worker data.

methods.name: _adoptNode
methods.description: Adopts a DOM node into the page context.

methods.name: _setFileInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for a file input element.

methods.name: _getContentQuads
methods.description: Retrieves layout quads for a DOM node.

methods.name: _describeNode
methods.description: Provides information about a DOM node.

methods.name: _scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls a node into view if needed.

methods.name: _getNodeBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of a node.

methods.name: _dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a keyboard event.

methods.name: _dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a touch event.

methods.name: _dispatchTapEvent
methods.description: Simulates a tap event at given coordinates.

methods.name: _getCurrentDragSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current drag session.

methods.name: _dispatchDragEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a drag event.

methods.name: _insertText
methods.description: Inserts text into the focused element.

methods.name: _crash
methods.description: Intentionally crashes the page for testing.
